heading: About Zobique
story: Zobique is an AI company from India. We build and run our own AI products, and through Zobique Labs we engineer AI systems that do real work inside other businesses.

Our first product, Zobique Career AI, helps students and early-career professionals turn their skills into job-ready applications. It is deployed for National Career Service users at ncs.zobique.com. Our second, Voicenity, is a voice agent that calls and qualifies sales leads in Hinglish and English; it is in early access.

connection.heading: How products and Labs connect
connection.body: Running our own products teaches us what it takes to keep AI working in a real operation: matching, generating documents, talking to people at scale. Zobique Labs brings that into client systems. When we solve the same problem for several clients, it can become reusable product capability.

items.title: How answering friends' career questions led me to build an AI startup in college
